msg: In the beginning, the brown gnome and green gnome seemed to give the highest amount of mushrooms. Once the numbers started being steady around 2 or 3 mushrooms coming from those colors, I switched to the pink and purply gnomes and they had higher numbers of mushrooms. It seems that green and brown give high amounts of mushrooms at the same time and pink and purple give high amounts of mushrooms at the same time. If you notice that one starts giving you lower amounts, switch to the other set of colors. I did this through the entirety of the game and I think I did really well!
